import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# Load the dataset from the provided string
csv_data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder
1,Male,27,Software Engineer,6.1,6,42,6,Overweight,126/83,77,4200,
2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# --- Data Cleaning and Preparation ---
# Fill empty 'Sleep Disorder' entries with a more descriptive label
df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('No Disorder', inplace=True)

# Split 'Blood Pressure' into 'Systolic' and 'Diastolic' columns for analysis
df[['Systolic', 'Diastolic']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# --- Visualization ---
# Set a professional and visually appealing style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="muted")
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Analysis of Sleep Quality and Related Health Metrics', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Sleep Duration vs. Quality of Sleep, colored by Sleep Disorder
sns.scatterplot(
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Duration',
    y='Quality of Sleep',
    hue='Sleep Disorder',
    size='Stress Level',
    sizes=(50, 250),
    style='BMI Category',
    alpha=0.8,
    palette={'No Disorder': '#3498db', 'Sleep Apnea': '#e74c3c'}
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Quality vs. Duration', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)')
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Legend', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Plot 2: Distribution of Heart Rate by Sleep Disorder
sns.boxplot(
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    data=df,
    x='Sleep Disorder',
    y='Heart Rate',
    palette={'No Disorder': '#3498db', 'Sleep Apnea': '#e74c3c'}
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Heart Rate Distribution by Disorder', fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')

# Plot 3: Physical Activity vs. Daily Steps by Occupation
sns.scatterplot(
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    data=df,
    x='Daily Steps',
    y='Physical Activity Level',
    hue='Occupation',
    s=150,
    style='Occupation',
    alpha=0.9
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Activity Level vs. Daily Steps', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Daily Steps')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Physical Activity Level (min/day)')
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Occupation')

# Plot 4: Blood Pressure by BMI Category
# Reshape data for easier plotting with seaborn
df_bp = df.melt(
    id_vars=['BMI Category'],
    value_vars=['Systolic', 'Diastolic'],
    var_name='BP Type',
    value_name='Value'
)
sns.barplot(
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    data=df_bp,
    x='BMI Category',
    y='Value',
    hue='BP Type',
    palette={'Systolic': '#c0392b', 'Diastolic': '#2980b9'}
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Average Blood Pressure by BMI', fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('BMI Category')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Blood Pressure (mmHg)')
axes[1, 1].legend(title='BP Type')

# Adjust layout and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.96])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
